business_problem: The Delhi Metro Rail Corporation (DMRC) is one of Asia’s largest transit networks, carrying more than seven million commuters every day across the Delhi-NCR region. With 395 kilometers of track and 289 stations, DMRC has long been a leader in transportation efficiency and safety in India’s capital.
solution_summary: Beyond the engineering teams, the platform empowers leadership through an interactive app interface built on Google Cloud, which provides real-time visibility into operational performance and enables timely strategic interventions from anywhere. In the background, Cloud SQL is used for maintaining logs and configuration tables, while Cloud Run is used for all small transactional processing functions. Underpinning all of this is a modular cloud architecture that standardizes data integration, ensuring that as DMRC expands its network, this digital backbone is ready to scale with it. This data-driven intelligence extends into the depot, where DMRC is transforming manual workflows with Generative AI. in Vertex AI helps the system decipher complex depot maintenance logs to automatically assign the correct sub-systems for repair.

solution_components.role: Orchestrates the platform's containerized services and high-concurrency workloads.

data_flow: stored or unified in BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL, processed with Vertex AI, orchestrated via Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), and surfaced through Gemini, Cloud Run
